statement: Partition {1, . . . , n} into q ≥ 1 nonempty blocks, and let Hi be the subgroup supported on block i. Suppose a probability w on Sn satisfies q X i=1 D(wHi ∥UG/Hi ) ≤ K. (13.1) 43 For every t > 0 there is a subprobability v ≤ w, of mass m, such that 1 − m ≤ K + q/e t , (13.2) v(gHi) ≤ et |Hi| |G| (g ∈ G, 1 ≤ i ≤ q), (13.3) X h∈Hi (v̌ ∗ v)(h) ≤ et |Hi| |G| , (13.4) ∥b v(λ)∥2 HS ≤ qCuet D −1+(u+2)/q λ (λ ⊢ n, u > 0). (13.5) Here v̌(g) = v(g−1), Cu is the constant in Theorem 6.3, the Fourier transform is the mass transform b v(λ) = P g v(g)ρλ(g), and the Hilbert–Schmidt norm is unnormalized.
